G4301.strongs: to take in advance, i.e. (literally) eat before others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to anticipate, surprise
senses: to take beforehand: with accusative, [[r:1CO.11.21|1Co 11:21]] (but see infr.).
to be beforehand, anticipate (in cl., with accusative, genitive or dative): with inf. (= cl. φθάνω, see Bl., § 69, 4; Swete, in l), [[r:MRK.14.8|Mrk 14:8.]]
to overtake, surprise: pass., [[r:GAL.6.1|Gal 6:1]] (on the virtual disappearance of the temporal force of the preposi­tion in this compound here and perhaps also in 1Co, l.with, see MM, xxi).† (AS)

G4302.strongs: to say beforehand, i.e. predict, forewarn
senses: to tell or say before­hand: [[r:2CO.13.2|2Co 13:2]], [[r:GAL.5.21|Gal 5:21]], [[r:1TH.3.4|1Th 3:4]] (R, txt.; cf. προεῖπον, but see infr.).
to declare, tell plainly: 2Co, Ga, 1Th, ll. with (R, mg.; see MM, xxi, and cf. Isa, l.with).† (AS)

G4303.strongs: to be a witness in advance i.e. predict
senses: προ-μαρτύρομαι to protest beforehand (cf. μαρτύρομαι, and V. Hort, in l): [[r:1PE.1.11|1Pe 1:11]] (elsewhere only in Theod. Met., xiv/AD.).† (AS)

G4306.strongs: to consider in advance, i.e. look out for beforehand (actively, by way of maintenance for others; middle voice by way of circumspection for oneself)
senses: to provide (RV, take thought for): with accusative of thing(s), καλά, [[r:ROM.12.17|Rom 12:17]] (-ούμενοι), [[r:2CO.8.21|2Co 8:21]] (-οῦμεν).
to provide for (before περί, Wis, l.with): with genitive of person(s), [[r:1TI.5.8|1Ti 5:8]] (-εῖ, WH, mg., -εῖται).† (AS)

G4307.strongs: forethought, i.e. provident care or supply
senses: (πρόνοος, careful) foresight, forethought: [[r:ACT.24.3|Act 24:3]]; π. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive (Dem., 546, 6), make provision for, show care for: [[r:ROM.13.14|Rom 13:14.]]† (AS)

G4308.strongs: to behold in advance, i.e. (actively) to notice (another) previously, or (middle voice) to keep in (one's own) view
senses: προ-οράω, -ῶ to see before (as to place or time): with accusative, [[r:ACT.21.29|Act 21:29.]] Mid., with accusative, before ἐνώπιόν μου, [[r:ACT.2.25|Act 2:25]] (LXX).† (AS)

G4309.strongs: to limit in advance, i.e. (figuratively) predetermine
senses: προ-ορίζω to predetermine, foreordain: with accusative, [[r:ROM.8.30|Rom 8:30]]; id. and inf., [[r:ACT.4.28|Act 4:28]]; id. before εἰς, [[r:1CO.2.7|1Co 2:7]], [[r:EPH.1.5|Eph 1:5]]; with dupl. accusative, [[r:ROM.8.26|Rom 8:26]]; pass., [[r:EPH.1.11|Eph 1:11.]]† (AS)
to suffer first or beforehand , (Herdotus Historicus), etc.: to be ill-treated before , ὑπό τινος (Thucydides):—;also, ἀγαθὸν πρ. (Xenophon Historicus) (ML)

G4311.strongs: to send forward, i.e. escort or aid in travel
G4311.kjv: accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth
senses: to set forward on a journey, escort: with accusative of person(s), [[r:1CO.16.11|1Co 16:11]], [[r:TIT.3.13|Tit 3:13]], 3Jn 6; before εἰς, [[r:ACT.20.38|Act 20:38]]; οὗ, [[r:1CO.16.6|1Co 16:6]]; ἕως, [[r:ACT.21.5|Act 21:5]]; pass., [[r:ACT.15.3|Act 15:3]], [[r:ROM.15.24|Rom 15:24]], [[r:2CO.1.16|2Co 1:16]].† (AS)
(προπίπτω), falling forwards, headlong. Metaphorical, precipitate, rash, reck­less: of persons, [[r:2TI.3.4|2Ti 3:4]]; of things, [[r:ACT.19.36|Act 19:36.]]† (AS)
προ-πορεύω to make to go before. Pass. and mid., to go before: [[r:LUK.1.76|Luk 1:76]], [[r:ACT.7.40|Act 7:40]]" (LXX),† (AS)

G4314.strongs: a preposition of direction; forward to, i.e. toward (with the genitive case, the side of, i.e. pertaining to; with the dative case, by the side of, i.e. near to; usually with the accusative case, the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the destination of the relation, i.e. whither or for which it is predicated)
G4314.kjv: about, according to, against, among, at, because of, before, between, (where-)by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), X together, to (you) -ward, unto, with(-in)
senses: I. C. genitive, of motion from a place, from the side of, hence metaphorically, in the interests of, [[r:ACT.27.34|Act 27:34]] (cf. Page, in l.).
II. C. dative, of local proximity, hard by, near, at: [[r:MRK.5.11|Mrk 5:11]], [[r:LUK.19.37|Luk 19:37]], [[r:JHN.18.16|Jhn 18:16 20:11, 12]] [[r:REV.1.13|Rev 1:13]].
C. accusative, of motion or direction towards a place or object, to, towards.

after verbs of motion or of speaking and other words with the idea of direction: ἔρχομαι, ἀναβαίνω, πορεύομαι, λέγω, ἐπιστολή, etc., [[r:MAT.3.14|Mat 3:14]], [[r:MRK.6.51|Mrk 6:51]], [[r:LUK.11.5|Luk 11:5]], [[r:JHN.2.3|Jhn 2:3]], [[r:ACT.9.2|Act 9:2]], al. mult.; metaphorically, of mental direction, hostile or otherwise, [[r:LUK.23.12|Luk 23:12]], [[r:JHN.6.52|Jhn 6:52]], [[r:2CO.7.4|2Co 7:4]], [[r:EPH.6.12|Eph 6:12]], [[r:COL.3.13|Col 3:13]], al.; of the issue or end, [[r:LUK.14.32|Luk 14:32]], [[r:JHN.11.4|Jhn 11:4]], al.; of purpose, [[r:MAT.26.12|Mat 26:12]], [[r:ROM.3.26|Rom 3:26]], [[r:1CO.6.5|1Co 6:5]], al.; πρὸς τό, with inf., denoting purpose (cf. M, Pr., 218, 220; Lft., Notes, 131), [[r:MAT.5.28|Mat 5:28]], [[r:MRK.13.22|Mrk 13:22]], [[r:EPH.6.11|Eph 6:11]], [[r:1TH.2.9|1Th 2:9]], al.;

of close proximity, at, by, with: [[r:MAT.3.10|Mat 3:10]], [[r:MRK.11.4|Mrk 11:4]], [[r:LUK.4.11|Luk 4:11]], [[r:ACT.3.2|Act 3:2]], al.; after εἶναι, [[r:MAT.13.56|Mat 13:56]], [[r:MRK.6.3|Mrk 6:3]], [[r:JHN.1.1|Jhn 1:1]], al.
for: πρὸς καιρόν, [[r:LUK.8.13|Luk 8:13]], [[r:1CO.7.5|1Co 7:5]]; πρὸς ὥραν, [[r:JHN.5.35|Jhn 5:35]], al.; πρὸς ὀλίγον, [[r:JAS.4.14|Jas 4:14.]]
προ-σάββατον, -ου, τό the day before the Sabbath: [[r:MRK.15.42|Mrk 15:42]] (L, Tr., txt., πρὸς σ.).† (AS)

G4316.root: from [[w:G4314]] and a derivative of [[w:G0058]] (mean to harangue)
G4316.strongs: to address, i.e. salute by name
senses: προσ-αγορεύω to address, greet, salute; hence, to call by name, address, style: with dupl. accusative, pass., [[r:HEB.5.10|Heb 5:10.]]† (AS)

G4317.strongs: to lead towards, i.e. (transitively) to conduct near (summon, present), or (intransitively) to approach
senses: trans., to bring or lead: with accusative and dative, [[r:ACT.16.20|Act 16:20]]; metaphorically, τ. θεῷ, [[r:1PE.3.18|1Pe 3:18]]; before ὧδε, [[r:LUK.9.41|Luk 9:41]]; pass., with dative, [[r:MAT.18.24|Mat 18:24]] (προσηνέχθη, T); in forensic sense, to summon: [[r:ACT.12.6|Act 12:6]] (προαγαγεῖν, T, WH, mg., R).
Intrans., to draw near, approach ([[r:JOS.3.9|Jos 3:9]], [[r:JER.26.3|Jer 26:3]] ([[r:JER.46.3|Jer 46:3]]), al.): with dative, [[r:ACT.27.27|Act 27:27]] (WH, προσαχεῖν).† (AS)
approach, access (see Lft., Notes, 284; MM, xxi): [[r:ROM.5.2|Rom 5:2]], [[r:EPH.2.18|Eph 2:18 3:12]] (but see Ellic., Eph., 59 f., where the transitive sense "introduction " is advocated).† (AS)
to continue asking; hence, to importune, beg, ask alms: [[r:JHN.9.8|Jhn 9:8.]]† (AS)

G4320.strongs: to ascend farther, i.e. be promoted (take an upper (more honorable) seat)

G4322.strongs: to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully
senses: προσ-αναπληρόω, -ῶ to fill up by adding to, to supply fully: [[r:2CO.9.12|2Co 9:12 11:9]].† (AS)

G4323.strongs: to lay up in addition, i.e. (middle voice and figuratively) to impart or (by implication) to consult
senses: προσ-ανα-τίθημι to lay on or offer besides; mid.,
to lay on oneself in addition, undertake besides;
with genitive of person(s), of giving or obtaining information, to consult, communicate: [[r:GAL.1.16|Gal 1:16 2:6]] (Lft., in l; cf. ἀνα-τίθημι) (AS)

G4326.strongs: to require additionally, i.e. want further

G4327.strongs: to admit (to intercourse, hospitality, credence, or (figuratively) endurance); by implication, to await (with confidence or patience)
senses: to receive to oneself, receive favourably, admit, accept: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.15.2|Luk 15:2]], [[r:ROM.16.2|Rom 16:2]], [[r:PHP.2.29|Php 2:29]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.24.15|Act 24:15]] (R, mg.), [[r:HEB.10.34|Heb 10:34 11:35]].

to expect, look for, wait for: with accusative of person(s), [[r:LUK.12.36|Luk 12:36]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MRK.15.43|Mrk 15:43]], [[r:LUK.2.25|Luk 2:25, 38 23:51]], [[r:ACT.23.21|Act 23:21]], [[r:TIT.2.13|Tit 2:13]], Ju 21 (cf. δέχομαι).† (AS)

G4328.strongs: to anticipate (in thought, hope or fear); by implication, to await
G4328.kjv: (be in) expect(-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for
senses: προσ-δοκάω, -ῶ (the simple verb exists only in the forms δοκέω, -εύω) to await, expect: [[r:MAT.24.50|Mat 24:50]], [[r:LUK.3.15|Luk 3:15 12:46]], [[r:ACT.27.33|Act 27:33 28:6]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.11.3|Mat 11:3]], [[r:LUK.1.21|Luk 1:21 7:19-20 8:40]] [[r:ACT.10.24|Act 10:24]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:2PE.3.12|2Pe 3:12-14]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.28.6|Act 28:6]]; with inf., [[r:ACT.3.5|Act 3:5.]]† (AS)

G4329.strongs: apprehension (of evil); by implication, infliction anticipated
senses: (ιροσδοκάω), expectation: with genitive obj., [[r:LUK.21.26|Luk 21:26]]; with genitive subjc., [[r:ACT.12.11|Act 12:11.]]† (AS)
to suffer to go further , τινά (New Testament) (ML)

G4332.root: from a compound of [[w:G4314]] and the base of [[w:G1476]]
G4332.strongs: to sit near, i.e. attend as a servant
senses: to attend regularly: with dative, [[r:1CO.9.13|1Co 9:13]], Rec. (see: παρεδρεύω).† παρ-εδρεύω to sit constantly beside, attend constantly (cf. MM, xix): τ. θυσιαστηρίω, [[r:1CO.9.13|1Co 9:13.]]† (AS)

G4333.strongs: to work additionally, i.e. (by implication) acquire besides
senses: to work or do service besides (Hdt., Plut.).
to gain besides, by working or trading: [[r:LUK.19.16|Luk 19:16]] (Xen.).† (AS)

G4334.strongs: to approach, i.e. (literally) come near, visit, or (figuratively) worship, assent to
G4334.kjv: (as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto)
senses: προσ-έρχομαι to approach, draw near: absol., [[r:MAT.4.11|Mat 4:11]], [[r:LUK.9.42|Luk 9:42]], al.; with infin., [[r:MAT.24.1|Mat 24:1]], al.; with dative loc., [[r:HEB.12.18|Heb 12:18, 22]]; dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.5.1|Mat 5:1]], and freq., [[r:JHN.12.21|Jhn 12:21]], al.; ptcp., προσελθών, with indic., [[r:MAT.8.2|Mat 8:2]], and freq., [[r:MRK.1.31|Mrk 1:31]], [[r:LUK.7.14|Luk 7:14]], al.; π. αὐτῷ, with indic., [[r:MAT.4.3|Mat 4:3]], [[r:MRK.6.35|Mrk 6:35]], Metaphorical,

of approaching God: absol. ([[r:LEV.21.17|Lev 21:17]], [[r:DEU.21.5|Deu 21:5]], al.), [[r:HEB.10.1|Heb 10:1, 22]]; τ. θεῷ, [[r:HEB.7.25|Heb 7:25 11:6]]; τ. θρόνῳ τ. χάριτος, [[r:HEB.4.16|Heb 4:16]]; πρὸς Χριστόν, [[r:1PE.2.4|1Pe 2:4]];
in sense not found elsewhere (Field, Notes, 211), to consent to: ὑγιαίνουσι λόγοις, [[r:1TI.6.3|1Ti 6:3]] (AS)

a place of prayer: of a synagogue ([[r:3MA.7.20|3Ma 7:20]], seel.; see Charles, APOT, i, 173; for other exx., see Kennedy, Sources, 114); of a place in the open (FlJ, Ant., xiv, 10, 23), [[r:ACT.16.13|Act 16:13, 16]].† SYN.: see: δέησις (AS)

G4336.strongs: to pray to God, i.e. supplicate, worship

G4337.strongs: (figuratively) to hold the mind (3563 implied) towards, i.e. pay attention to, be cautious about, apply oneself to, adhere to
G4337.kjv: (give) attend(-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to unto); have regard
senses: to turn to, bring to (frequently ναῦν, expressed or understood, to bring to port, land; Hdt., al.).

τ. νοῦν, before dative, to turn one's mind to, attend to; in Xen. and later writers with νοῦν omitted (El., § 53, 1; 81, 1): [[r:ACT.8.6|Act 8:6 16:14]], [[r:HEB.2.1|Heb 2:1]], [[r:2PE.1.19|2Pe 1:19]]; in sense of caring or providing for, [[r:ACT.20.28|Act 20:28]]; π. ἑαυτῷ, to give heed to oneself (M, Pr., 157; cf. [[r:GEN.24.6|Gen 24:6]], [[r:EXO.10.28|Exo 10:28]], al.): [[r:LUK.17.3|Luk 17:3 21:34]], [[r:ACT.5.35|Act 5:35]]; id. before ἀπό (M, Pr., 102; B1., § 34, 11; 40, 3; see: βλέπω), [[r:LUK.12.1|Luk 12:1]]; (without dative) [[r:MAT.7.15|Mat 7:15 10:17 16:6, 11-12]], [[r:LUK.20.46|Luk 20:46]] (cf. [[r:SIR.6.13|Sir 6:13]], al.); before μή, with inf. (M, Pr., 193; Bl., § 69, 4), [[r:MAT.6.1|Mat 6:1.]]

to attach or devote oneself to: with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.8.10|Act 8:10-11]], [[r:1TI.4.1|1Ti 4:1]]; with dative of thing(s), [[r:1TI.1.4|1Ti 1:4 3:8 4:13 6:3]] T (-ερχ-, WH, R), [[r:TIT.1.14|Tit 1:14]], [[r:HEB.7.13|Heb 7:13]].† (AS)

G4338.strongs: to peg to, i.e. spike fast
senses: προσ-ηλόω -ῶ to nail to: with accusative and dative, figuratively, [[r:COL.2.14|Col 2:14.]]† (AS)

G4339.strongs: an arriver from a foreign region, i.e. (specially), an acceder (convert) to Judaism ("proselyte")
senses: one who has arrived, a stranger.
Of converts to Judaism, a proselyte (see DB, see word): [[r:MAT.23.15|Mat 23:15]], [[r:ACT.2.10|Act 2:10 6:5 13:43]].† (AS)

G4340.strongs: for the occasion only, i.e. temporary
G4340.kjv: dur-(eth) for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal
senses: for a season, temporary, transient: [[r:2CO.4.18|2Co 4:18]], [[r:HEB.11.25|Heb 11:25]]; of plants, short-lived: [[r:MAT.13.21|Mat 13:21]], [[r:MRK.4.17|Mrk 4:17]].† (AS)

G4341.strongs: to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite
senses: προσ-καλέω, -ῶ to call to. Mid., to call to oneself (see M, Pr., 157): with accusative of person(s), [[r:MAT.10.1|Mat 10:1]], [[r:MRK.3.13|Mrk 3:13 6:7]], [[r:LUK.7.19|Luk 7:19]], [[r:ACT.5.40|Act 5:40]], [[r:JAS.5.14|Jas 5:14]], al. Metaphorical, of the Divine call: [[r:ACT.2.39|Act 2:39]]; with inf., [[r:ACT.16.10|Act 16:10]] (see Bl., § 69, 4); before εἰς, [[r:ACT.13.2|Act 13:2.]]† (AS)

G4342.strongs: to be earnest towards, i.e. (to a thing) to persevere, be constantly diligent, or (in a place) to attend assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to adhere closely to (as a servitor)
G4342.kjv: attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually)
senses: προσ-καρτερέω, -ῶ (καρτερός, strong, stedfast) to attend constantly, continue stedfastly, adhere to, wait on: with dative of person(s), [[r:MRK.3.9|Mrk 3:9]], [[r:ACT.8.13|Act 8:13 10:7]]; with dative of thing(s), [[r:ACT.1.14|Act 1:14 2:42 6:4]], [[r:ROM.12.12|Rom 12:12]], [[r:COL.4.2|Col 4:2]]; before ἐν, [[r:ACT.2.46|Act 2:46]]; εἰς, [[r:ROM.13.6|Rom 13:6.]]† (AS)

G4344.root: neuter of a presumed compound of [[w:G4314]] and [[w:G2776]]
G4344.strongs: something for the head, i.e. a cushion

G4345.strongs: to give a common lot to, i.e. (figuratively) to associate with
senses: προσ-κληρόω, -ῶ to allot to, assign to by lot; pass. (but perh. as nid., EV, consorted with, so Syr.): [[r:ACT.17.4|Act 17:4]] (for exx., v, Cremer, 749).† (AS)

G4347.strongs: to glue to, i.e. (figuratively) to adhere
senses: προσ-κολλάω, -ῶ, to glue to; pass., reflexive, to stick to, cleave to (Plat.): metaphorically (with dative, [[r:JOS.23.8|Jos 23:8]], [[r:SIR.6.34|Sir 6:34]] al.), before πρός, [[r:MRK.10.7|Mrk 10:7]] (R, txt.), [[r:EPH.5.31|Eph 5:31]] (LXX).† (AS)

G4348.strongs: a stub, i.e. (figuratively) occasion of apostasy
senses: a stumble, stumbling: λίθος προσκόμματος (= נֶגֶף אֶבֶן, Isa, l.with), figuratively, [[r:ROM.9.32|Rom 9:32-33]], [[r:1PE.2.8|1Pe 2:8]]" (LXX);
= προσκοπή, an occasion of stumbling, a stumbling-block: metaphorically, [[r:ROM.14.13|Rom 14:13, 20]], [[r:1CO.8.9|1Co 8:9]] (Plut.).† SYN.: σκάνδαλον (cf. Cremer, 752 f.) (AS)

G4349.strongs: a stumbling, i.e. (figuratively and concretely) occasion of sin

G4350.strongs: to strike at, i.e. surge against (as water); specially, to stub on, i.e. trip up (literally or figuratively)
senses: trans., to strike (e.g. hand or foot) against: with accusative before πρός, figuratively, [[r:MAT.4.6|Mat 4:6]], [[r:LUK.4.11|Luk 4:11]], (LXX)

Intrans., to stumble: absol. ([[r:TOB.11.9|Tob 11:9]], [[r:PRO.3.23|Pro 3:23]]), [[r:JHN.11.9|Jhn 11:9-10]]; of wind, to rush against, beat upon: with dative, [[r:MAT.7.27|Mat 7:27.]] Metaphorical, in late writers,
to take offence at, stumble at: before ἐν, [[r:ROM.14.21|Rom 14:21]]; with dative, τ. λόγῳ, [[r:1PE.2.8|1Pe 2:8]]; τ. λίθῳ τ. προσκόμματος, [[r:ROM.9.32|Rom 9:32.]]† (AS)

G4351.strongs: to roll towards, i.e. block against
senses: προσ-κυλίω to roll up, roll to: with accusative and dative, [[r:MAT.27.60|Mat 27:60]]; accusative before ἐπί, [[r:MRK.15.46|Mrk 15:46.]]† (AS)

G4352.root: from [[w:G4314]] and a probable derivative of [[w:G2965]] (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master's hand)
G4352.strongs: to fawn or crouch to, i.e. (literally or figuratively) prostrate oneself in homage (do reverence to, adore)
senses: προσ-κυνέω, -ῶ (κυνέω, to kiss), to make obeisance, do reverence to, worship;

prop. (as in cl., of the gods: Hdt., Æsch., Plat., al.), of God, Christ and supra-mundane beings: absol., [[r:JHN.4.20|Jhn 4:20 12:20]], [[r:ACT.8.27|Act 8:27 24:11]], [[r:HEB.11.21|Heb 11:21]] (Westc., in l), [[r:REV.11.1|Rev 11:1]]; πίπτειν καὶ π., [[r:REV.5.14|Rev 5:14]]; with dative (of the significance of this constr. as com­pared with the usual cl., with accusative, see Abbott, JG, 78 f.; JV, 133 ff.), [[r:JHN.4.21|Jhn 4:21, 23]], [[r:ACT.7.43|Act 7:43]], [[r:1CO.14.25|1Co 14:25]], [[r:HEB.1.6|Heb 1:6]], [[r:REV.4.10|Rev 4:10 7:11 11:16 13:4, 15 14:7 16:2 19:4, 10 19:20 22:8-9]]; with accusative (see supr.), [[r:MAT.4.10|Mat 4:10]], [[r:LUK.4.8|Luk 4:8 24:52]] (WH, R, mg., om.), [[r:JHN.4.22|Jhn 4:22, 24]], [[r:REV.9.20|Rev 9:20 13:4, 8 13:12 14:9, 11 20:4]]; Seq. ἐπώπιον, [[r:LUK.4.7|Luk 4:7]], [[r:REV.15.4|Rev 15:4]];

as in cl., of homage to human superiors (cf. MM, xxi): absol., [[r:MAT.20.20|Mat 20:20]], [[r:ACT.10.25|Act 10:25]]; with dative (see supr.), [[r:MAT.2.2|Mat 2:2, 8 8:2 9:18 14:33 15:25 18:26 28:9]], [[r:MRK.15.19|Mrk 15:19]], [[r:JHN.9.38|Jhn 9:38]]; πεσὼν., [[r:MAT.2.11|Mat 2:11 4:9]]; ἐνώπιον τ. ποδῶν, [[r:REV.3.9|Rev 3:9]]; with accusative, [[r:MRK.5.6|Mrk 5:6]] (dative T).† (AS)

G4354.strongs: to talk to, i.e. converse with
senses: προσ-λαλέω, -ῶ to speak to: [[r:ACT.28.20|Act 28:20]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:ACT.13.43|Act 13:43.]]† (AS)

G4355.strongs: to take to oneself, i.e. use (food), lead (aside), admit (to friendship or hospitality)
senses: to take to oneself, take, receive; in NT always mid., -ομαι;
of things: of food, with accusative, [[r:ACT.27.33|Act 27:33]]; with genitive part., [[r:ACT.27.36|Act 27:36]];
of persons: with accusative, [[r:MAT.16.22|Mat 16:22]], [[r:MRK.8.32|Mrk 8:32]] (see Swete, in l), [[r:ACT.17.5|Act 17:5 18:26 28:2]], [[r:ROM.14.1|Rom 14:1, 3 15:7]], Phm 17.† (AS)

G4357.strongs: to stay further, i.e. remain in a place, with a person; figuratively, to adhere to, persevere in
G4357.kjv: abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with)
senses: to wait longer, continue, remain still: [[r:ACT.18.18|Act 18:18]]; before ἐν, [[r:1TI.1.3|1Ti 1:3.]]

C. dative, to remain with: [[r:MAT.15.32|Mat 15:32]], [[r:MRK.8.32|Mrk 8:32]]. Metaphorical, to remain attached to, cleave unto, abide in: τ. κυρίῳ, [[r:ACT.11.23|Act 11:23]] (R, txt.; ἐν τ. κ., R, mg., see supr.); τ. χάριτι τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ACT.13.43|Act 13:43]]; τ. δεήσεσιν, [[r:1TI.5.5|1Ti 5:5.]]† (AS)

G4358.root: from [[w:G4314]] and a derivative of the same as [[w:G3730]] (meaning to tie (anchor) or lull)
G4358.strongs: to moor to, i.e. (by implication) land at
senses: προσ-ορμίζω (ὅρμος, an anchorage), to bring a ship to anchor at; usually in mid., to come to anchor near, and so pass. in late writers (Ael., Dio Cass.): [[r:MRK.6.53|Mrk 6:53.]]† (AS)

to owe besides or still , (Thucydides): absolute, προσοφείλοντας ἡμᾶς ἐνέγραψεν (Demosthenes Orator):—;Pass. to be still owing, be still due , (Thucydides); so, ἡ ἔχθρη ἡ προσοφειλομένη ἐς Ἀθηναίους ἐκ τῶν Αἰγινητέων the hatred which was still due from the Aeginetans to the Athenians, i. e. their ancient feud, (Herdotus Historicus) (ML)

G4360.root: from [[w:G4314]] and a form of ὀχθέω (to be vexed with something irksome)

G4362.strongs: to fasten to, i.e. (specially), to impale (on a cross)

G4363.strongs: to fall towards, i.e. (gently) prostrate oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to rush upon (in storm)
senses: to fall upon, strike against: with dative, of wind, [[r:MAT.7.25|Mat 7:25.]]

to fall down at one's feet, fall prostrate before: absol., before πρός, [[r:MRK.7.25|Mrk 7:25]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:MRK.3.11|Mrk 3:11 5:33]], [[r:LUK.8.28|Luk 8:28]], [[r:ACT.16.29|Act 16:29]]; τ. γόνασιν, [[r:LUK.5.8|Luk 5:8.]]† (AS)

G4364.strongs: to do forward for oneself, i.e. pretend (as if about to do a thing)
senses: προσ-ποιέω, -ῶ to make over to, add or attach to. Mid., to take to oneself, claim; hence, to pretend; with inf. (cf. Xen., Anab., iv, 3, 20), to make as if: [[r:LUK.24.28|Luk 24:28.]]† (AS)

G4365.strongs: to journey towards, i.e. approach (not the same as)
senses: προσ-πορεύομαι to come near, approach: with dative of person(s), [[r:MRK.10.35|Mrk 10:35.]]† (AS)

G4366.strongs: to tear towards, i.e. burst upon (as a tempest or flood)

senses: with accusative of person(s), to place at, to attach to.

to give a command, enjoin, appoint: [[r:LUK.5.14|Luk 5:14]]; with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.1.24|Mat 1:24]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.8.4|Mat 8:4]], [[r:MRK.1.44|Mrk 1:44]]; with accusative and inf., [[r:ACT.10.48|Act 10:48]]; pass., [[r:ACT.10.33|Act 10:33 17:26]].† (AS)

G4369.strongs: to place additionally, i.e. lay beside, annex, repeat
G4369.kjv: add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more
senses: to add, join to, give in addition: with accusative before ἐπί, [[r:MAT.6.27|Mat 6:27]], [[r:LUK.3.20|Luk 3:20 12:25]]; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό, [[r:ACT.2.47|Act 2:47]]; with accusative and dative, [[r:LUK.17.5|Luk 17:5]], [[r:HEB.12.19|Heb 12:19]] (see MM, xxi); pass., absol., [[r:ACT.2.41|Act 2:41]], [[r:GAL.3.19|Gal 3:19]]; with dative, [[r:MAT.6.33|Mat 6:33]], [[r:MRK.4.24|Mrk 4:24]], [[r:LUK.12.31|Luk 12:31]], [[r:ACT.5.14|Act 5:14 11:24]]; προσιτέθη πρὸς τ. πατέρας (cf. [[r:GEN.26.8|Gen 26:8]], [[r:JDG.2.10|Jdg 2:10]], al.), [[r:ACT.13.36|Act 13:36]]; with inf., of repeating or continuing the action signified by the following verb, as in Heb. idiom ([[r:GEN.4.2|Gen 4:2 8:12]], al.; cf. WM, § 54, 5; Lft. on Clem., 1Co., xii; but see also M, Pr., 67, 233; Deiss., BS, 67.1; MM, xxi), [[r:LUK.20.11|Luk 20:11]], [[r:ACT.12.3|Act 12:3]]; similarly ptcp., προσ-θείς, with indic. ([[r:GEN.38.5|Gen 38:5]], al.), [[r:LUK.19.11|Luk 19:11]].† (AS)

G4370.strongs: to run towards, i.e. hasten to meet or join

G4371.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of [[w:G4314]] and [[w:G5315]]
G4371.strongs: something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare)
senses: (φαγεῖν), Hellenistic for ὄψον ὀψάριον) a relish or dainty (esp, cooked fish), to be eaten with bread: [[r:JHN.21.5|Jhn 21:5]] (have ye taken any fish, Field, Notes, 109; Abbott, Essays, 105; cf. M, Pr., 170n; MM, Exp., xxi).† (AS)
(on the derivation, see Boisacq, see word and cf. -ως),
Generally (from Æsch. on), new, fresh, recent: ὁδός, [[r:HEB.10.20|Heb 10:20]] (see MM, Exp., xxi; Rutherford, NPhr., 471 f.).† (AS)

G4374.strongs: to bear towards, i.e. lead to, tender (especially to God), treat
G4374.kjv: bring (to, unto), deal with, do, offer (unto, up), present unto, put to
senses: to bring to, lead to: with accusative and dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.4.24|Mat 4:24 8:16 9:2, 32 14:35 17:16]], [[r:MRK.2.4|Mrk 2:4]] (WH, R, txt.; sc. αὐτόν) [[r:MRK.10.13|Mrk 10:13]], [[r:LUK.18.15|Luk 18:15 23:14]]; pass., [[r:MAT.12.22|Mat 12:22]] (act., WH, txt.) [[r:MAT.18.24|Mat 18:24]] (προσήχθη, WH) [[r:MAT.19.13|Mat 19:13]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:MAT.25.20|Mat 25:20]]; id. with dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.22.19|Mat 22:19]], [[r:LUK.23.36|Luk 23:36]]; τ. στόματι, [[r:JHN.19.29|Jhn 19:29]]; metaphorically, with dative of person(s), to deal with, [[r:HEB.12.7|Heb 12:7]] (cl.).

to offer: [[r:MAT.2.11|Mat 2:11]], [[r:ACT.8.18|Act 8:18]]; esp. (as frequently in LXX; cf. FlJ, Ant., iii, 9, 3) sacrifices, gifts and prayers to God: absol., before περί (ὑπέρ), [[r:MRK.1.44|Mrk 1:44]], [[r:LUK.5.14|Luk 5:14]], [[r:HEB.5.1|Heb 5:1, 3 9:7 10:12]]; pass., [[r:ACT.21.26|Act 21:26]]; with accusative of thing(s) (δῶρον, θυσίαν, λυτρείαν, προσφοράν), [[r:MAT.5.23|Mat 5:23-24]] (aoristic pres.; M, Pr., 247) [[r:MAT.8.4|Mat 8:4]], [[r:JHN.16.2|Jhn 16:2]], [[r:ACT.7.42|Act 7:42 21:26]], [[r:HEB.5.1|Heb 5:1 8:3-4 9:7, 9 10:1-2, 8 10:11-12]]; δεήσεις τε κ. ἱκετηρίας, [[r:HEB.5.7|Heb 5:7]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:HEB.11.17|Heb 11:17]] (conative impf.; M, Pr., 129); of Christ, [[r:HEB.7.27|Heb 7:27]] (ἀνενέγκας, WH, txt.) [[r:HEB.9.14|Heb 9:14, 25 9:28]].† (AS)

G4375.root: from a presumed compound of [[w:G4314]] and [[w:G5368]]
senses: of persons, in both act, and pass. sense (LXX, ll. with);

G4376.strongs: presentation; concretely, an oblation (bloodless) or sacrifice
senses: (Less frequently in cl.), a present, an offering; in NT, of sacrificial offerings: [[r:ACT.21.26|Act 21:26 24:17]], [[r:EPH.5.2|Eph 5:2]], [[r:HEB.10.5|Heb 10:5, 8 10:14]]; περί ἀμαρτίας, [[r:HEB.10.18|Heb 10:18]]; with genitive obj., [[r:ROM.15.16|Rom 15:16]], [[r:HEB.10.10|Heb 10:10]].† (AS)

G4377.strongs: to sound towards, i.e. address, exclaim, summon
senses: to address, call to; in cl., with accusative of person(s), with dupl. accusative (cf. 2Mac, l.with); absol. (Hom., Od., v, 159, al.): [[r:ACT.21.40|Act 21:40]] In late writers, with dative of person(s): [[r:MAT.11.16|Mat 11:16]], [[r:LUK.7.32|Luk 7:32 13:12 23:20]], [[r:ACT.22.2|Act 22:2]].
to call by name, summon: with accusative (as in cl.), [[r:LUK.6.13|Luk 6:13.]]† (AS)

G4378.root: from a comparative of [[w:G4314]] and χέω (to pour)

G4379.strongs: to impinge, i.e. lay a finger on (in order to relieve)
senses: προσ-ψαύω in poët. and late writers, to touch: with dative, [[r:LUK.11.46|Luk 11:46.]]† (AS)

G4380.strongs: to favor an individual, i.e. show partiality
senses: προσωπολημπτέω (Rec. -ληπτ-), -ῶ (-λήμπτης, which see), to have respect of persons: [[r:JAS.2.9|Jas 2:9.]]† (AS)

G4381.strongs: an accepter of a face (individual), i.e. (specially), one exhibiting partiality
senses: προσωπο-λήμπτης (Rec. -λήπτης, see Bl., § 6, 8), -ου, ὁ (πρόσωπον λαμβάνειν, see: πρόσωπον), a respecter of persons: [[r:ACT.10.34|Act 10:34]] (on this group of cognate forms, see Mayor, da., 78 f.; and cf. Thackeray, Gr., 44).† (AS)
προσωπολημψία (Rec. -ληψία), -ας, ἡ (προσωπολήμπτης) respect of persons: [[r:ROM.2.11|Rom 2:11]], [[r:EPH.6.9|Eph 6:9]], [[r:COL.3.25|Col 3:25]], [[r:JAS.2.1|Jas 2:1]] (see Mayor, in l).† (AS)

G4383.strongs: the front (as being towards view), i.e. the countenance, aspect, appearance, surface; by implication, presence, person
G4383.kjv: (outward) appearance, X before, countenance, face, fashion, (men's) person, presence
senses: prop., of persons (so always in cl.);

the face, countenance: [[r:MAT.6.16|Mat 6:16-17]], [[r:MRK.14.65|Mrk 14:65]], [[r:LUK.9.29|Luk 9:29]], [[r:2CO.3.7|2Co 3:7]], [[r:REV.4.7|Rev 4:7]], al.; τὸ π. τῆς γενέτεως (EV, natural face), [[r:JAS.1.23|Jas 1:23]]; πίπτειν ἐπὶ (τὰ) π., [[r:MAT.17.6|Mat 17:6]], [[r:LUK.5.12|Luk 5:12]], [[r:REV.7.11|Rev 7:11]], al.; ἀγνοούμενος τῷ π., [[r:GAL.1.22|Gal 1:22]]; π., οὐ καρδίᾳ, [[r:1TH.2.17|1Th 2:17]]; κατὰ πρόσωπον (in front, facing: Thuc., Xen., al.), when present, face to face, [[r:ACT.25.16|Act 25:16]], [[r:2CO.10.1|2Co 10:1 10:7]], [[r:GAL.2.11|Gal 2:11]]; id. with genitive, as compound prep., in the presence of (not cl.; see Bl., § 40, 9; M, Pr., 99 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.), [[r:LUK.2.31|Luk 2:31]], [[r:ACT.3.13|Act 3:13]]; similarly ἀπὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים מִלִּפְּנֵי); see Dalman, Words, 29), from the presence of, [[r:ACT.3.19|Act 3:19 5:41 7:45]], [[r:2TH.1.9|2Th 1:9]], [[r:REV.12.14|Rev 12:14 20:11]]; πρὸ π. (Heb. (פָּנִים לִפְנֵי), before, [[r:MAT.11.10|Mat 11:10]], [[r:MRK.1.2|Mrk 1:2]], [[r:LUK.7.27|Luk 7:27]]" (LXX), al.; in other phrases resembling Heb. idiom (Thackeray, Gr., 42), βλέπειν (ὁρᾶν, θεωρεῖν, ἰδεῖν) τὸ π., to see one's face, i.e. see him in person, [[r:MAT.18.10|Mat 18:10]], [[r:ACT.20.25|Act 20:25, 38]], [[r:1TH.3.10|1Th 3:10]], [[r:REV.22.4|Rev 22:4]]; ἐμφανισθῆναι τῷ π. τοῦ θεοῦ, [[r:HEB.9.24|Heb 9:24]]; ἐν π. Χριστοῦ, [[r:2CO.2.10|2Co 2:10 4:6]]; μετὰ τοῦ π. σου with thy presence, [[r:ACT.2.28|Act 2:28]] (LXX); εἰς π. τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν, [[r:2CO.8.24|2Co 8:24]]; στηρίζειν τὸ π. (Heb. פָּנִים שׂוּם: [[r:JER.21.10|Jer 21:10]], al.; see Dalman, Words, 30), with inf., to set one's face towards, [[r:LUK.9.51|Luk 9:51]]; similarly, τὸ π. αὐτοῦ ἦν πορευόμενον (op. cit., 31), [[r:LUK.9.53|Luk 9:53]]; τὸ π. τοῦ κυρίου ἐπί, [[r:1PE.3.12|1Pe 3:12]] (LXX)

form, person: καυχᾶσθαι. ἐν π. καὶ μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ, [[r:2CO.5.12|2Co 5:12]] (cf. [[r:1SA.16.7|1Ki 16:7]]); metaphorically, as in Heb. idiom, of judgment according to appearance, external condition or circumstances (פָּנִים H5387; see Dalman, Words, 30; Thackeray, Gr., 43 f.): λαμβάνειν π., [[r:LUK.20.21|Luk 20:21]], [[r:GAL.2.6|Gal 2:6]]; βλέπειν εἰς π., [[r:MAT.22.16|Mat 22:16]], [[r:MRK.12.14|Mrk 12:14]]; θαυμάζειν πρόσωπα, Ju 16.

G4385.strongs: to protend, i.e. tie prostrate (for scourging)
senses: προ-τείνω, to stretch out, stretch forth: of preparations for scourging (see Field, Notes, 136 f.), [[r:ACT.22.25|Act 22:25.]]† (AS)

G4386.root: neuter of [[w:G4387]] as adverb (with or without the article)
senses: before; (adv.) before, formerly, an earlier time former, prior, [[r:EPH.4.22|Eph 4:22]]; before, former, prior, [[r:EPH.4.22|Eph 4:22]]; before, formerly, [[r:JHN.6.62|Jn 6:62]]

G4388.strongs: to place before, i.e. (for oneself) to exhibit; (to oneself) to propose (determine)
senses: to set before, set forth publicly; so also in mid.: with accusative of person(s), [[r:ROM.3.25|Rom 3:25]] (for a suggested alt, rend., see MM, xxii).
Mid., to set before oneself, propose, purpose: with inf., [[r:ROM.1.13|Rom 1:13]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:EPH.1.9|Eph 1:9.]]† (AS)

G4389.root: middle voice from [[w:G4253]] and the base of [[w:G5157]]
G4389.strongs: to turn forward for oneself, i.e. encourage
senses: προ-τρέπω to urge forwards, exhort, persuade. Mid., in same sense (as also in cl.): [[r:ACT.18.27|Act 18:27.]]† (AS)

G4390.strongs: to run forward, i.e. outstrip, precede
senses: to run on, run in advance: [[r:JHN.20.4|Jhn 20:4]]; before εἰς τὸ ἔμπροσθεν, [[r:LUK.19.4|Luk 19:4.]]† (AS)

G4391.strongs: to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously
senses: to be before or previously: with ptcp., [[r:LUK.23.12|Luk 23:12]], [[r:ACT.8.9|Act 8:9]].† (AS)
προφέρω to bring forth: with accusative of thing(s), before ἐκ, [[r:LUK.6.45|Luk 6:45.]]† (AS)

(προψητεύω) the gift (and its exercise) of interpreting the Divine will and purpose, prophecy, prophesying: of OT prophecy, [[r:MAT.13.14|Mat 13:14]], [[r:2PE.1.20|2Pe 1:20-21]]; of NT prophecy, [[r:ROM.12.6|Rom 12:6]], [[r:1CO.12.10|1Co 12:10 13:2 14:6 14:22]], [[r:1TI.4.14|1Ti 4:14]], [[r:REV.11.6|Rev 11:6 22:19]]; pl., [[r:1CO.13.8|1Co 13:8]], [[r:1TH.5.20|1Th 5:20]], [[r:1TI.1.18|1Ti 1:18]]; οἱ λόγοι τῆς π., [[r:REV.1.3|Rev 1:3 22:7, 10 22:18]]; τ. πνεῦμα τῆς π., [[r:REV.19.10|Rev 19:10]] (Luc., FlJ, LXX, π.; see Deiss., BS, 235 f.; MM, xxii).† (AS)

G4395.strongs: to foretell events, divine, speak under inspiration, exercise the prophetic office
senses: (προφήτης), to be a προφήτης (which see), to prophesy: in the primary sense of telling forth the Divine counsels, [[r:MAT.7.22|Mat 7:22 26:68]], [[r:MRK.14.65|Mrk 14:65]], [[r:LUK.1.67|Luk 1:67 22:64]], [[r:ACT.19.6|Act 19:6]], [[r:1CO.11.4|1Co 11:4-5 13:9 14:1 14:3-5 14:24 14:31 14:39]], [[r:HEB.11.3|Heb 11:3]]; with the idea of foretelling future events (an idea merely incidental, not essential; see Lft., Notes, 83 f.), [[r:MAT.11.13|Mat 11:13]], [[r:ACT.2.17|Act 2:17-18]]" (LXX) [[r:ACT.21.9|Act 21:9]]; before περί, [[r:MAT.15.7|Mat 15:7]], [[r:MRK.7.6|Mrk 7:6]], [[r:1PE.1.10|1Pe 1:10]]; ἐπί, with dative, [[r:REV.10.11|Rev 10:11]]; λέγων, Ju 14; ὅτι, [[r:JHN.11.51|Jhn 11:51.]]† SYN.: μαντεύομαι, q.v (AS)

G4396.strongs: a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet
senses: one who acts as an interpreter or forth-teller of the Divine will (see Lft., Notes, 83f.; Tr., Syn., §vi), a prophet;
in cl. (Æsch., Hdt., Plat., al.), of the interpreters of oracles.

of prophets in general: [[r:MAT.10.41|Mat 10:41 13:57 21:46]], [[r:MRK.6.4|Mrk 6:4]], [[r:LUK.13.33|Luk 13:33]], al.; (with) of John the Baptist: [[r:MAT.21.26|Mat 21:26]], [[r:MRK.6.15|Mrk 6:15]], [[r:LUK.1.76|Luk 1:76]];
of Christian prophets in the apostolic age: [[r:ACT.15.32|Act 15:32]], [[r:1CO.12.28|1Co 12:28]], [[r:EPH.2.20|Eph 2:20]], al.;
by meton., of the writings of prophets: [[r:LUK.24.27|Luk 24:27]], [[r:ACT.8.28|Act 8:28]], al.;
of a poet: [[r:TIT.1.12|Tit 1:12]] (on the use of the term in π. and Inscr., see Deiss., BS, 235f.; MM, xxii). (AS)

G4398.strongs: a female foreteller or an inspired woman

G4399.strongs: to get an earlier start of, i.e. anticipate
senses: προ-φθάνω with ptcp. (as in cl., but more frequently the simple φθάνω, which see), to anticipate: [[r:MAT.17.25|Mat 17:25.]]† (AS)

before, of time, place, rank, etc.; in NT always of Time, before, former: [[r:EPH.4.22|Eph 4:22.]] Adverbially, πρότερον, before, aforetime, formerly: [[r:JHN.7.50|Jhn 7:50]], [[r:2CO.1.15|2Co 1:15]], [[r:HEB.4.6|Heb 4:6]]; opposite to ἔπειτα, [[r:HEB.7.27|Heb 7:27]]; τὸ π., [[r:JHN.6.62|Jhn 6:62 9:8]], [[r:GAL.4.13|Gal 4:13]], [[r:1TI.1.13|1Ti 1:13]]; αἱ π. ἡμέραι, [[r:HEB.10.32|Heb 10:32]]; αἱ π. ἐπιθυμίαι, [[r:1PE.1.14|1Pe 1:14.]]† (AS)
